en.s: The Battle of Adrianople was fought in Thrace on July 3, 324, during a Roman civil war, the second to be waged between the two emperors Constantine I and Licinius. Licinius was soundly defeated and his army suffered heavy casualties. Constantine built up military momentum, winning further battles on land and sea, eventually leading to the final defeat of Licinius at Chrysopolis.

zh.s: 阿德里安堡战役于324年7月3日在色雷斯爆发，是罗马内战中的一场战役，也是君士坦丁一世与李锡尼两位皇帝之间的第二次内战。李锡尼惨败，军队伤亡惨重。君士坦丁乘势继续作战，在陆上和海上取得更多胜利，最终于克里索波利斯彻底击败李锡尼。

en.t: Hugh Capet is crowned King of France, the first of the Capetian dynasty that would rule France until the French Revolution in 1792
en.s: Hugh Capet (; French: Hugues Capet [yɡ kapɛ]; c. 941 – 24 October 996) was the King of the Franks from 987 to 996. He is the founder of and first king from the House of Capet. The son of the powerful duke Hugh the Great and Hedwige of Saxony, he was elected as the successor of the last Carolingian king, Louis V.

zh.s: 于格·卡佩（法语：Hugues Capet [yɡ kapɛ]；约941年—996年10月24日）是987年至996年的法兰克人国王。他创建了卡佩家族，并成为该王朝首位国王。他是权势强大的大于格公爵与萨克森的赫德维希之子，经推选继承最后一位加洛林王朝国王路易五世。

en.t: Jack Cade and his followers enter London unhindered by the government of king Henry VI
en.s: Jack Cade's Rebellion or Cade's Rebellion was a popular revolt in 1450 against the government of England, which took place in the south-east of the country between the months of April and July. It stemmed from local grievances regarding the corruption, maladministration and abuse of power of the king's closest advisors and local officials, as well as recent military losses in France during the Hundred Years' War.

zh.t: 杰克·凯德及其追随者在亨利六世政府未加阻拦的情况下进入伦敦
zh.s: 杰克·凯德起义（又称凯德起义）是1450年反对英格兰政府的一场民众起义，发生在该国东南部，持续时间为当年4月至7月。起义源于民众对国王亲信顾问和地方官员腐败、治理不善及滥用职权的不满，也与英格兰在百年战争期间近期于法国遭受的军事失败有关。

en.s: The Battle of Cochin, sometimes referred as the second siege of Cochin, was a series of confrontations, between March and July 1504, fought on land and sea, principally between the Portuguese garrison at Cochin, allied to the Trimumpara Raja, and the armies of the Zamorin of Calicut and vassal Malabari states. The celebrated heroics of the tiny Portuguese garrison, led by Duarte Pacheco Pereira, fended off an invading army several hundred times bigger.

en.t: Diego de Almagro leaves the recently conquered Inca capital of Cuzco to lead an expedition to Chile
en.s: Diego de Almagro (Spanish: [ˈdjeɣo ðe alˈmaɣɾo]; c. 1475 – July 8, 1538), also known as El Adelantado and El Viejo, was a Spanish conquistador known for his exploits and killings in western South America. He participated with Francisco Pizarro in the Spanish conquest of Peru. While subduing the Inca Empire he laid the foundation for Quito and Trujillo as Spanish cities in present-day Ecuador and Peru, respectively.

zh.t: 迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗离开刚征服的印加首都库斯科，率领远征队前往智利
zh.s: 迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗（西班牙语：[ˈdjeɣo ðe alˈmaɣɾo]；约1475年—1538年7月8日），又称“先驱者”和“老人”，是一名西班牙征服者，以其在南美洲西部的征战和杀戮闻名。他与弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗一同参与西班牙征服秘鲁。征服印加帝国期间，他为基多和特鲁希略奠定了城市基础，这两座城市如今分别位于厄瓜多尔和秘鲁。

en.s: The naval battle of Barcelona was a naval engagement of the Franco-Habsburg War fought off Barcelona from 29 June to 3 July 1642 between a Spanish fleet commanded by Juan Alonso Idiáquez, Duke of Ciudad Real, and a French fleet under Jean Armand de Maillé-Brézé, Duc de Fronsac.

en.s: The Battle of Fort Necessity (also called the Battle of the Great Meadows) took place on July 3, 1754, in what is now the mountaintop hamlet of Farmington in Fayette County, Pennsylvania. The engagement was one of the first battles of the French and Indian War and George Washington's only military surrender. The battle, along with the May 28 Battle of Jumonville Glen, contributed to a series of military escalations that resulted in the global Seven Years' War. Washington built Fort Necessity on an alpine meadow west of the summit of a pass through the Allegheny Mountains.

zh.s: 内西蒂堡战役又称大草甸战役，于1754年7月3日在今美国宾夕法尼亚州费耶特县法明顿山顶聚落一带发生。这是法国—印第安人战争最早的几场战斗之一，也是乔治·华盛顿唯一一次军事投降。此战与5月28日的朱蒙维尔格伦战役共同引发了一系列军事升级，最终演变为全球范围的七年战争。华盛顿在阿勒格尼山脉一处山口西侧的高山草甸上修建了内西蒂堡。

en.s: On July 3, 1767, the newspaper now known as Adresseavisen published its first issue in Trondheim, Norway. It began as a classified advertising publication.

en.s: The Battle of Wyoming was a military engagement during the American Revolutionary War between Patriot militia and a force of Loyalist soldiers and Iroquois warriors. The battle took place in the Wyoming Valley of Pennsylvania on July 3, 1778, in what is now Luzerne County. The result was an overwhelming defeat for the Patriots. The battle is often referred to as the Wyoming Massacre because of the roughly 300 Patriot casualties, many of whom were killed by the Iroquois as they fled the battlefield or after they had been taken prisoner.

zh.s: 怀俄明战役是美国独立战争期间爱国者民兵与保王党士兵和易洛魁战士组成的部队之间的一场军事交战。战斗于1778年7月3日在宾夕法尼亚州怀俄明谷、今卢塞恩县境内发生。爱国者一方遭到惨败。由于约有300名爱国者伤亡，其中许多人在逃离战场或被俘后遭易洛魁人杀害，这场战斗常被称为“怀俄明大屠杀”。

en.s: The War of the Bavarian Succession (German: Bayerischer Erbfolgekrieg; 3 July 1778 – 13 May 1779) was a dispute between the Austrian Habsburg monarchy and an alliance of Saxony and Prussia over succession to the Electorate of Bavaria after the extinction of the Bavarian branch of the House of Wittelsbach. The Habsburgs sought to acquire Bavaria, and the alliance opposed them, favoring another branch of the Wittelsbachs.

zh.t: 巴伐利亚王位继承战争
zh.s: 巴伐利亚王位继承战争（德语：Bayerischer Erbfolgekrieg）发生于1778年7月3日至1779年5月13日。巴伐利亚维特尔斯巴赫家族支系绝嗣后，奥地利哈布斯堡王朝与萨克森、普鲁士联盟围绕巴伐利亚选侯国继承权发生争端。哈布斯堡王朝试图取得巴伐利亚，联盟则支持维特尔斯巴赫家族的另一支系，反对奥地利的计划。

en.s: The Battle of Lintulaks was fought between Swedish and Russian forces at Lintulaks (Lintulahti, an inn at a crossroads in the village of Kyyjärvi) in Finland on 3 July 1808 during the Finnish War.

zh.s: 芬兰战争期间，瑞典和俄罗斯军队于1808年7月3日在芬兰林图拉克斯交战。林图拉克斯（Lintulahti）是芬兰基于耶尔维村道路交叉口的一家旅店。

en.s: The Action of 3 July 1810 was a minor naval engagement of the Napoleonic Wars, in which a French frigate squadron under Guy-Victor Duperré attacked and defeated a convoy of Honourable East India Company East Indiamen near the Comoros Islands. During the engagement the British convoy resisted strongly and suffered heavy casualties but two ships were eventually forced to surrender. These were the British flagship, the Windham, which held off the French squadron to allow the surviving ship Astell to escape, and the Ceylon.

zh.s: 1810年7月3日海战是拿破仑战争期间的一场小规模海战。居伊-维克托·迪佩雷率领法国护卫舰分舰队，在科摩罗群岛附近袭击并击败了英国东印度公司的一支商船队。交战中，英国船队顽强抵抗，伤亡惨重，但最终有两艘船被迫投降。其中，英国旗舰“温德姆号”拖住了法国分舰队，使幸存的“阿斯特尔号”得以逃脱；另一艘被俘的是“锡兰号”。

en.s: The Niagara campaign occurred in 1814 and was the final campaign launched by the United States to invade Canada during the War of 1812. The campaign was launched to counter the British offensive in the Niagara region which had been initiated with the capture of Fort Niagara in December, 1813.

en.s: The Battle of Locust Grove was a small-scale confrontation of the American Civil War in the Indian Territory on July 3, 1862. About 250 Union troops commanded by Colonel William Weer, surprised approximately 300 Confederate troops commanded by Colonel James J. Clarkson, who were encamped near Pipe Springs. The Confederates, unable to form a battle line, were quickly dispersed into a thicket of locust trees.

Lee as part of his plan to break through Union lines and achieve a decisive victory in the North. The charge was named after Major General George Pickett, one of the Confederate Army's division commanders.

zh.s: 皮克特冲锋是1863年7月3日葛底斯堡战役期间的一次步兵冲锋，由南方邦联将军罗伯特·E·李下令实施，属于其突破联邦军防线、在北方取得决定性胜利计划的一部分。这次冲锋以南方邦联陆军师长乔治·皮克特少将命名。

en.s: The Battle of Lundby happened south of Lundby in northeast Himmerland on 3 July 1864 in the Second War of Schleswig. A Danish company of the First Regiment tried a head-on bayonet charge down a long hillside, but stopped 20 meters in front of the earth dike that the Prussians lay in cover behind. This battle was the last in the Second War of Schleswig, and resulted in great Danish losses.

zh.s: 伦德比战役于1864年7月3日在日德兰半岛东北部欣默兰地区伦德比以南发生，属于第二次石勒苏益格战争。丹麦第一团一个连试图沿长山坡正面发起刺刀冲锋，但在距离普鲁士人藏身的土堤20米处停下。这是第二次石勒苏益格战争的最后一场战斗，丹麦方面损失惨重。

en.s: The Battle of Königgrätz (or Battle of Sadová; Czech: Bitva u Hradce Králové) was the decisive battle of the Austro-Prussian War in which the Kingdom of Prussia defeated the Austrian Empire. It took place on 3 July 1866, near the Bohemian city of Hradec Králové (German: Königgrätz) and village of Sadová, now in the Czech Republic.

en.s: The Battle of Santiago de Cuba was a decisive naval engagement that occurred on July 3, 1898, between an American fleet, led by William T. Sampson and Winfield Scott Schley, against a Spanish fleet led by Pascual Cervera y Topete, which occurred during the Spanish–American War. The significantly more powerful US Navy squadron, consisting of four battleships and two armored cruisers, decisively defeated an outgunned squadron of the Spanish Navy, consisting of four armored cruisers and two destroyers. All of the Spanish ships were sunk for no American loss.

zh.s: 圣地亚哥-德古巴海战是美西战争期间的一场决定性海战，于1898年7月3日爆发。威廉·T·桑普森和温菲尔德·斯科特·施莱指挥的美国舰队与帕斯夸尔·塞尔维拉·伊·托佩特指挥的西班牙舰队交战。美国海军分舰队实力远胜对手，由4艘战列舰和2艘装甲巡洋舰组成，彻底击败了由4艘装甲巡洋舰和2艘驱逐舰组成的西班牙舰队。西班牙舰船全部沉没，美方没有损失。

en.s: The 1901 New South Wales state election was held on 3 July 1901 for all of the 125 seats in the 19th New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in single-member constituencies with a first past the post voting system. The Parliamentary Electorates Act of 1893 had conferred the right to vote on every male British subject over 21 years of age who was resident in New South Wales for a year or more.

en.s: The Simla Convention (Traditional Chinese: 西姆拉條約; Simplified Chinese: 西姆拉条约), officially the Convention Between Great Britain, China, and Tibet, was an ambiguous treaty concerning the status of Tibet negotiated by representatives of the Republic of China, Tibet and Great Britain in Simla and Delhi during 1913–1914, with the eventual signing of the Convention taking place in Simla. The Simla Convention provided that Tibet would be divided into "Outer Tibet" and "Inner Tibet".

en.s: The Battle of Guayacanas was fought on 3 July 1916 between Dominican rebels and the United States during the United States occupation of the Dominican Republic. The Dominicans dug trenches on two hills blocking passage to Santiago and kept up single-shot fire against the automatic weapons of the Americans before the Americans drove them off. Joseph A. Glowin, a corporal, was awarded the Medal of Honor for his bravery during the action.

The caretaker government of Professor Aimo Cajander (Progressive), that President Kaarlo Juho Ståhlberg had appointed in June 1922, following the resignation of Prime Minister Juho Vennola (Progressive), remained in office until Kyösti Kallio formed an Agrarian-Progressive minority government in November 1922.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland between 1 and 3 July 1933. The Social Democratic Party remained the largest party in Parliament with 78 of the 200 seats. However, Prime Minister Toivo Mikael Kivimäki of the National Progressive Party continued in office after the elections, supported by Pehr Evind Svinhufvud and quietly by most Agrarians and Social Democrats. They considered Kivimäki's right-wing government a lesser evil than political instability (various short-lived governments) or an attempt by the radical right to gain power. Voter turnout was 62.2%.

zh.s: 芬兰于1933年7月1日至3日举行议会选举。社会民主党仍是议会最大党，在200个席位中赢得78席。尽管如此，民族进步党籍总理托伊沃·米凯尔·基维迈基在选举后继续执政，得到佩尔·埃温德·斯温胡武德以及多数农民联盟和社会民主党人的暗中支持。他们认为，基维迈基的右翼政府总好过政局不稳、政府频繁更迭，或激进右翼试图夺权。投票率为62.2%。

en.s: The Attack on Mers-el-Kébir, part of Operation Catapult and also known as the Battle of Mers-el-Kébir, was a British naval bombardment of the French Navy (Marine nationale) at its base at Mers El Kébir on the coast of French Algeria on 3 July 1940. The raid resulted in the deaths of 1,297 French servicemen, the sinking of a battleship and the damaging of five other ships. The combined air-and-sea attack was conducted by the Royal Navy in response to the Second Armistice at Compiègne between Germany and France on 22 June, which had seen Britain's sole continental ally replaced by a collaborationist government administrated from Vichy.

zh.s: 梅尔斯埃尔克比袭击是“弹射行动”的一部分，也称梅尔斯埃尔克比海战。1940年7月3日，英国海军炮击了法国海军驻扎在法属阿尔及利亚沿岸梅尔斯埃尔克比基地的舰队。袭击造成1,297名法国军人死亡，一艘战列舰沉没，另有五艘舰船受损。英国海军实施了海空联合攻击，回应的是6月22日德国与法国签订的《第二次贡比涅停战协定》：英国在欧洲大陆唯一的盟友由此被一个以维希为中心的合作政府取代。

en.s: The Battle of Deir ez-Zor was part of the Allied invasion of Syria during the Syria-Lebanon campaign in World War II. The Battle of Deir ez-Zor is noted for the bold outflanking tactics employed by Allied field commander William "Bill" Slim of Iraq Command. These tactics presaged Slim's employment of similar tactics in 1945 while commanding the British Fourteenth Army in Burma.

zh.s: 代尔祖尔之战是第二次世界大战期间盟军入侵叙利亚、开展叙利亚—黎巴嫩战役的一部分。盟军伊拉克司令部的战地指挥官威廉·“比尔”·斯利姆运用了大胆的迂回战术，使这场战斗颇受关注。1945年，斯利姆指挥英国第十四集团军在缅甸作战时也采用了类似战术。

en.s: The Minsk offensive (Russian: Минская наступательная операция) was part of the second phase of the Belorussian strategic offensive of the Red Army in summer 1944, commonly known as Operation Bagration. The Red Army encircled the German Fourth Army in the city of Minsk. German dictator Adolf Hitler ordered the Fourth Army to hold fast, declaring the city to be a fortified place (fester Platz) to be defended even if encircled.
en.n: World War II: The Minsk Offensive clears German troops from the city.

zh.s: 明斯克攻势（俄语：Минская наступательная операция）是1944年夏季红军白俄罗斯战略攻势第二阶段的一部分，通常称为“巴格拉季昂行动”。红军包围了位于明斯克市内的德军第四集团军。德国独裁者阿道夫·希特勒命令第四集团军坚守阵地，宣布明斯克为“要塞”（fester Platz），即使被包围也必须守住。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：明斯克攻势把德军赶出该市。

en.s: The Falls Curfew, also called the Battle of the Falls (or Lower Falls), was a British Army operation during 3–5 July 1970 in the Falls district of Belfast, Northern Ireland. The operation began as a search for weapons in the staunchly Irish nationalist district. As the search ended, local youths attacked the British soldiers with stones and petrol bombs and the soldiers responded with CS gas.

zh.s: 大卫·罗伯特·琼斯（1947年1月8日—2016年1月10日），艺名大卫·鲍伊，是英国歌手、词曲作者和演员。他被视为20世纪最具影响力的音乐人之一，以不断变化的形象和视觉风格著称，常被称为“摇滚变色龙”。他的音乐、舞台表现和时尚风格对流行文化产生了重大影响。

en.s: Iran Air Flight 655 was an international scheduled passenger flight from Tehran to Dubai via Bandar Abbas that was shot down on 3 July 1988 by two surface-to-air missiles fired by USS Vincennes, a United States Navy warship. The missiles hit the Iran Air aircraft, an Airbus A300, while it was flying its usual route over Iran's territorial waters in the Persian Gulf, shortly after the flight departed its stopover location, Bandar Abbas International Airport.

zh.t: 伊朗航空655号班机遭击落事件
zh.s: 伊朗航空655号班机是一趟国际定期客运航班，从德黑兰经班达尔阿巴斯飞往迪拜。1988年7月3日，美国海军军舰“文森斯号”发射两枚舰对空导弹将其击落。导弹击中伊朗航空的空客A300客机；事发时，飞机刚离开经停地班达尔阿巴斯国际机场，正按常规航线飞越伊朗在波斯湾的领海。

en.s: Operation Eagle was a Sri Lanka Air Force operation to resupply and rescue critically wounded service personal from the old Dutch Fort of Jaffna held by the Sri Lanka Army and besieged by the LTTE on July 3, 1990. The successful rescue operation gained headlines, leading to much rejoicing island-wide and helped increase morale.

en.s: The 2003 Bawean incident was an incident on 3 July 2003 where two Indonesian Air Force F-16 Fighting Falcons were sent to intercept five US Navy F/A-18 Hornets fighter jets from the aircraft carrier USS Carl Vinson. The F-16s and F/A-18s engaged in a dogfight, missile lock and electronic warfare near Bawean Island in the Java Sea, north of Java.

zh.s: 2003年巴韦安岛事件发生于2003年7月3日。当时两架印度尼西亚空军F-16“战隼”战斗机奉命拦截美国海军航空母舰“卡尔·文森号”上的五架F/A-18“大黄蜂”战斗机。双方飞机在爪哇以北的爪哇海巴韦安岛附近发生空中缠斗、火控雷达锁定和电子战。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in the State of México on Sunday, 3 July 2005.Voters in Mexico's most populous state went to the polls to elect a governor to replace former incumbent Arturo Montiel Rojas of the Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI). The favorite candidate was PAN's Rubén Mendoza. It was thought the first runner-up would be PRD Yeidckol Polevnsky Gurwitz (born as Citlali Ibáñez Camacho) and last place by PRI's Enrique Peña. However, Rubén Mendoza made several mistakes in his campaign, appearing apparently drunk at events, boasting he led a group of supporters to steal campaign gifts from Peña's team and gave them with his own signature (he was taped while doing this).

zh.s: 墨西哥州于2005年7月3日（星期日）举行州长选举，选民投票选出新州长，接替革命制度党（PRI）前任州长阿图罗·蒙铁尔·罗哈斯。最初被看好的候选人是国家行动党（PAN）的鲁文·门多萨。人们原以为第二名会是民主革命党（PRD）的耶德科尔·波列文斯基·古尔维茨（本名西特拉莉·伊瓦涅斯·卡马乔），革命制度党的恩里克·培尼亚则会垫底。但门多萨在竞选中犯下多次错误：他在活动上看起来像喝醉了，还吹嘘自己带支持者偷走培尼亚团队的竞选礼品，再贴上自己的签名送人；这一过程被拍了下来。

en.s: General elections were held in Mauritius on 3 July 2005, with votes counted on 4 July. The Alliance Sociale, a coalition led by the Mauritian Labour Party (PTr) and including the Mauritian Party of Xavier-Luc Duval (PMXD), the Mauritian Social Democrat Party (MSN), Les Verts (Greens), the Republican Movement, and the Mauritian Militant Socialist Movement (MMSM), won the election with 42 of the 70 seats (38 elected directly, and another 4 nominated under the country's "best loser" system).

zh.s: 毛里求斯于2005年7月3日举行大选，7月4日统计选票。社会联盟由毛里求斯工党（PTr）领导，成员包括毛里求斯泽维尔-吕克·杜瓦尔党（PMXD）、毛里求斯社会民主党（MSN）、绿党、共和运动和毛里求斯激进社会主义运动（MMSM）。该联盟赢得70个席位中的42席，其中38席由直接选举产生，另有4席根据该国的“最佳落选者”制度提名。

en.s: The Valencia Metro derailment occurred in Valencia, Spain's third largest city, on 3 July 2006 at 1 p.m. CEST (1100 UTC) between Jesús and Plaça d'Espanya stations on the Line 1 of the Metrovalencia mass transit system. At least 43 people were killed and more than ten were seriously injured. Valencian forensic scientists identified all but one of the victims — a woman whose family has not claimed her, according to El País.

zh.t: 瓦伦西亚地铁脱轨事故
zh.s: 2006年7月3日欧洲中部夏令时间下午1时（协调世界时11时），瓦伦西亚地铁1号线一列列车在耶稣站与西班牙第三大城市瓦伦西亚的西班牙广场站之间脱轨。至少43人死亡，10多人重伤。瓦伦西亚法医确认了除一名女性以外所有遇难者的身份；据《国家报》报道，这名女性的家人尚未认领她。

zh.s: UFC 116：莱斯纳对卡温是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）举办的综合格斗赛事，于2010年7月3日在内华达州拉斯维加斯的米高梅大花园竞技场举行。这场赛事在2010年《摔角观察家通讯》奖项评选中获评“最佳大型赛事”，这是UFC赛事首次获得该奖。按付费观看销量计算，这是UFC历史上第三高的赛事，仅次于UFC 194。

The final was contested by Westmeath of Leinster and Kerry of Munster, with Westmeath winning by 2-16 to 1-18.

zh.s: 2010年克里斯蒂·林杯决赛是一场板棍球比赛，于2010年7月3日在克罗克公园举行，决出该届克里斯蒂·林杯冠军。这是该项赛事第六个赛季，由盖尔运动协会主办，参赛队伍属于第二级别。决赛由伦斯特省的韦斯特米斯郡对阵芒斯特省的凯里郡，最终韦斯特米斯以2比16对1比18获胜。

en.s: On July 3, 2013, then-President of Egypt Mohamed Morsi was overthrown by a coup d'etat led by Egyptian army chief General Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, who led a coalition to remove Morsi from power and suspend the Egyptian constitution of 2012. en.s: The 2019 Bulgarian Supercup was the 16th Bulgarian Supercup, an annual Bulgarian football match played between the winners of the previous season's First Professional Football League and Bulgarian Cup. This was Ludogorets's seventh Bulgarian Supercup appearance and Lokomotiv Plovdiv's third.

zh.s: 2019年保加利亚超级杯是第16届保加利亚超级杯，由上一赛季保加利亚足球甲级联赛和保加利亚杯的冠军球队交锋。比赛双方是2018—19赛季甲级联赛冠军卢多戈雷茨，以及2019年保加利亚杯冠军普罗夫迪夫火车头。这是卢多戈雷茨第7次参加超级杯，也是普罗夫迪夫火车头第3次参加。

en.s: Verano de Escándalo (Spanish for "Summer of Scandal") was a major professional wrestling event produced by the Mexican Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) promotion, which took place on July 3, 2021 at an unknown location in Tequisquiapan, Querétaro, Mexico. The Verano de Escándalo event has been a regular summer event for AAA since 1997, only skipping the event in 2012, 2013, 2016, and 2020. 2021 marked the 21st time AAA has used that name for an event and the first Verano de Escándalo event since 2019.

zh.s: 《丑闻之夏》（西班牙语：Verano de Escándalo，意为“丑闻之夏”）是墨西哥AAA世界摔角联盟制作的一场大型职业摔角赛事，于2021年7月3日在墨西哥克雷塔罗州特基斯基亚潘一处地点不明的场馆举行。自1997年以来，该赛事一直是AAA的常规夏季活动，仅在2012、2013、2016和2020年停办。2021年是AAA第21次使用这一名称举办赛事，也是2019年以来首次举办《丑闻之夏》。

en.s: The Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival (Korean: 부천국제판타스틱영화제; Hanja: 富川國際판타스틱映畵祭), or BiFan, formerly known as Puchon International Fantastic Film Festival or PiFan, is an international film festival held annually in July in Bucheon, South Korea. Inaugurated in 1997, the festival focuses on South Korean and international horror, thriller, mystery and fantasy films, with particular attention to Asian cinema from East Asia and Southeast Asia.

zh.s: 富川国际奇幻电影节（韩语：부천국제판타스틱영화제；汉字：富川國際판타스틱映畵祭），简称BiFan，原名富川国际奇幻电影节（Puchon International Fantastic Film Festival，PiFan），是韩国富川每年7月举办的国际电影节。电影节创办于1997年，主要展映韩国及国际恐怖、惊悚、悬疑和奇幻电影，尤其关注东亚和东南亚电影。
